//: Copy to ~/.claude/flow.local.json (personal) or .claude/flow.json (shared with the repo).

verify.//: Inner loop must be cheap. syntaxCheck runs per edit; targeted builds one test target.
verify.//extra: Checks run after the formatter, each only when its condition holds. Write the condition after a #, e.g. "scripts/check-config.sh   # when anything under config/ changed".
verify.//formatGuard: Regex for the project's tree-wide formatter command. The bash guard blocks a match that has no --file and no FLOW_TREEWIDE_OK=1. Null disables the guard.

review.//: Findings below floor are dropped. 80 is the plugin default; raise it if noise annoys you.

mr.//template: Markdown file for the MR description: absolute, ~/..., or relative to the repo root. Null uses the built-in Summary / How to test / Notes layout.
mr.//assignee: "me" assigns the user running flow; null leaves the MR unassigned.
mr.//reviewers: null adds none and leaves project defaults; "none" also removes any the project adds; or a list of usernames.
